title: Game Tengoku: The Game Paradise!
overview:
Making a grand entrance as a complete port plus a super-arranged version!!

Must listen!! Three theme songs sung by popular voice actors, and a soulful insert song sung by Takayuki Miyauchi!!

The mad scientist Genius Yamada is using the power of arcade machines to take over the You&Me Kamiyoga game center, and he has his sights set on every arcade in the world. Clerk Yuki Ito calls on a team of game heroes to stop him. Fly through vertically scrolling worlds themed on amusement machines and video games, blasting comical enemies and taking on Yamada at the end of each world.

Power up your shot by collecting items, hold the fire button to charge each character's special attack, and use bombs to clear the screen in a pinch. A second player can join in at any time.

- Arcade Mode, playable in horizontal or vertical screen layout
- Arrange Mode with a new character, two new worlds (Karaoke World and Console World), remixed music and voiced story scenes
- Face a karaoke boss who sings and dances

完全移植版＋超アレンジ版で大登場!!

必聴!!
人気声優の歌う主題歌３曲と宮内タカユキの歌う魂の挿入歌!!
